meta.title: feat: implement ISR for booking pages with Google Calendar webhook integration

core_change_summary.description: Added Next.js unstable_cache with 1-hour revalidation to the booking page ([user]/[type]) and Google Calendar webhook handler to trigger revalidation via server actions and a fallback task queue.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most churn is from the cache-eligibility.ts file (278 lines added/removed) before migration to EventTypeRepository; final cleanup commit by hbjORbj reduced unnecessary code.
